entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True)

pattern=re.compile(rf'/{year}-')
files_this_year=sorted([p for p in cable_files if re.search(pattern,p)])
print('files_this_year',len(files_this_year),files_this_year)

amounts=[]
for f in files_this_year:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=f)['content']
    # find Total Amount => ... possibly contains $ and decimals
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    print('file',f,'match',m.group(1) if m else None)
    if m:
        amounts.append(float(m.group(1)))
    else:
        # try alternative line 'Total Amount => 77'
        m2=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        print('file',f,'alt_match',m2.group(1) if m2 else None)
        if m2:
            amounts.append(float(m2.group(1)))

print('amounts',amounts,'sum',sum(amounts))

# round to 2 decimals for currency
sum_rounded=round(sum(amounts)+1e-9,2)
print('sum_rounded',sum_rounded)

from datetime import datetime
import re

now=datetime.now(); year=now.year

# login file_system
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
file_pw = next(d['password'] for d in pw_list if d.get('account_name')=='file_system')
resp = apis.file_system.login(username='chrharrison@gmail.com', password=file_pw)
access_token=resp['access_token']

entries = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', recursive=True)
cable_files=[p for p in entries if '/cable/' in p and p.endswith('.txt')]
pattern=re.compile(rf'/{year}-')
files_this_year=sorted([p for p in cable_files if re.search(pattern,p)])
print('year',year)
print('files_this_year',len(files_this_year),files_this_year)

amounts=[]
for f in files_this_year:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=access_token, file_path=f)['content']
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    val=float(m.group(1)) if m else None
    print('file',f,'total_amount',val)
    amounts.append(val)

total=round(sum(amounts)+1e-9,2)
print('total',total)

apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total)
